project_type: Vite + React SPA with Convex backend, Capacitor mobile wrapper
build_system: pnpm with vite build (tsc -b && vite build). Convex deploys separately via npx convex deploy. Capacitor sync via npx cap sync.
test_framework: No automated test framework currently. Validation is via pnpm build (TypeScript check + Vite build).
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm build to verify TypeScript compilation and Vite bundling succeeds. 2. Check dist/ output exists with expected files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated by vite build but not checked in. convex/_generated/ is auto-generated by convex CLI.
environment_constraints: Convex CLI and Vercel CLI require auth tokens not available in sandbox. Code/config changes only. No docker daemon. Internet available for package installation.
contribution_requirements: Korean language for UI text. Design system uses navy/gold color palette. Mobile-first max-width 480px. Uses lucide-react icons.
key_patterns: Pages in src/pages/, components in src/components/, lib utilities in src/lib/. Convex functions in convex/. Routes defined in App.tsx. Layout.tsx handles nav/header. Cards component pattern in components/cards.tsx. UI primitives in components/ui.tsx.
directory_structure: Root: config files (vite, ts, vercel, capacitor). src/: React app (App.tsx, main.tsx, pages/, components/, lib/). convex/: backend functions + schema. android/: Capacitor Android project. ios/: Capacitor iOS project. public/: PWA assets, icons, SW. scripts/: gen-assets.mjs.
